title: WellSpan pilots Hippocratic AI phone agent for cancer-screening outreach with clinician monitoring
summary: WellSpan Health, an eight-hospital system based in York, Pennsylvania, is piloting a Hippocratic AI conversational agent that telephones English- and Spanish-speaking patients who have not engaged with colorectal cancer screening, with a second agent preparing low-risk patients for scheduled colonoscopies and following up afterwards. Initial pilot calls are monitored by a human clinician, Hippocratic AI provides WellSpan clinicians with a complete transcript of each conversation for review, and some calls are transferred live to a clinician or followed up by one later.
verification_note: URL fetched on 2026-10-17. Article by David Raths, dated Sept. 26, 2024, confirms the pilot, live clinician monitoring of initial calls, complete transcripts delivered to WellSpan clinicians, and live transfer of some calls to a clinician. The page gives no escalation criteria, call volumes, monitoring period or model name. The agent acts by placing outbound patient calls and transferring them, not by tool or code execution.
